en: Black‑and‑white view of a landscaped city park with tall leafy trees, curving gravel paths, small shrubs, benches, and an ornate multi‑tiered fountain surrounded by a low mesh fence. Several children lean on the fence near the fountain. In the background, partially obscured by trees, is a classical European-style building with large windows. The overall look suggests an early‑to‑mid 20th century urban garden scene.
